ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_004_cost_adv_rank_margin_normalized_v2_shifted_agg_repaired_fixed
ir.intuition: Clamp weights and intermediate exponentials to prevent infinite/nan; preserve margin and logsumexp aggregation.
ir.pseudocode: eps=1e-8; adv_margin=softplus(advantage_gap*5-2)*0.03; rank_margin=tanh(delta_rank*3)*0.025; margin=adv_margin+rank_margin; x=alpha*scale*(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)-margin; loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(x)*clamp(weight,eps); shift=mean(loss_per_pair); sum_exp_loss=sum(exp(clamp(loss_per_pair - shift, -50, 50))); logw_safe=log(clamp(weight, eps)); shift_logw=mean(logw_safe); sum_exp_logw=sum(exp(clamp(logw_safe - shift_logw, -50, 50))); loss=log(sum_exp_loss+eps)+shift - (log(sum_exp_logw+eps)+shift_logw); return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    weight = batch['weight']
    weight_clamped = ops.clamp(weight, min=eps)

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.2))

    adv_margin = ops.softplus(advantage_gap * 5.0 - 2.0) * 0.03
    rank_margin = ops.tanh(delta_rank * 3.0) * 0.025
    margin = adv_margin + rank_margin

    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - margin
    loss_per_pair = -ops.logsigmoid(x) * weight_clamped

    shift = ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
    shifted_loss = ops.clamp(loss_per_pair - shift, min=-50.0, max=50.0)
    sum_exp_loss = ops.sum(ops.exp(shifted_loss))

    logw_safe = ops.log(weight_clamped)
    shift_logw = ops.mean(logw_safe)
    shifted_logw = ops.clamp(logw_safe - shift_logw, min=-50.0, max=50.0)
    sum_exp_logw = ops.sum(ops.exp(shifted_logw))

    logsumexp_loss = ops.log(sum_exp_loss + eps) + shift
    logsumexp_logw = ops.log(sum_exp_logw + eps) + shift_logw

    return logsumexp_loss - logsumexp_logw
